
## e2e-console-reference.html — DO NOT EDIT

This is the E2E console mock exactly as Mark approved it. It is the acceptance criterion for the
"E2E Tests" tab: every tile, column, button, filter and panel in this file must exist and function
in the live tab. Do not reformat it, do not "tidy" it, do not let a formatter touch it — a reference
that has been edited is no longer evidence of what was approved. If the design changes, Mark
approves a new mock and it replaces this file wholesale.
